name: Flexor Pulley Injury of the Finger
tags: flexor pulley injury of the finger
definition: Injury to the digital flexor pulley system, especially A2/A4, commonly in climbers and capable of causing bowstringing.

typical: Sudden finger pain during crimp grip

investigations.principle: Dynamic ultrasound or MRI can define pulley rupture.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Multiple complete pulley ruptures may require surgical reconstruction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anguli-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Injury to the digital flexor pulley system, especially A2/A4, commonly in climbers and capable of causing bowstringing.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
